title: Lagrangian Side-by-Side Report

canonical_node.axiom: The framework's truth is not decided by this harness; it only checks whether each candidate behaves like a disciplined formal model under the same test bench.
definitions: chi / chi_bar: coherence weight; higher means the system can carry ordered motion.
S_entropy / S_v1: entropy drag; higher means more disorder pressure.
W: resistance or grace leak; higher means the system resists alignment.
chi10: upward source term; think coherence support, grace support, or Christ-source term.
Gamma9: downward sink term; think decoherence drain, adversary sink, or collapse pressure.
xdot / Fdot / Fsum_dot: activity term; motion through the system.
V: stored potential cost; what the system has to carry or overcome.
derivation: The harness defines five shared regimes (balanced, resistance_drag, source_rich, sink_heavy, entropy_heavy) with fixed parameter values.
Each candidate Lagrangian is evaluated under these regimes, producing regime values and deltas vs balanced.
Dimension checks verify that terms added or subtracted share the same dimension class (action_density).
Euler-Lagrange equations are derived symbolically where a single time-dependent generalized coordinate is declared.
Cross-model checks verify algebraic relationships (e.g., Anti = -Spirit, v2 zero-resistance limit).
Preregistered predictions (P1-P5, P7, P10) are tested against the computed results.
Wrong-control variants are run through the same gauntlet to test whether the canonical structure matters.
Invariant search identifies algebraic invariants or symmetry residues under constrained transformations.
canonical_node.action: Use this harness to evaluate candidate Lagrangian models for disciplined formal behavior, checking dimension compatibility, response signs, Euler-Lagrange closure, and preregistered predictions.
boundary: This harness does not decide whether the framework is true.
It does not claim full Noether conserved quantities; only algebraic invariants under constrained transforms.
It does not derive theological relations; it only reports what is and is not derived.
It does not claim that passing checks establishes physical truth.
test: Dimension checks: PASS for all models.
Cross-model checks: anti_vs_spirit, llc_v2_zero_resistance_limit, llc_v1_core_reference, resistance_penalty_sign, source_sink_direction, historical_vs_canonical_note all PASS.
Preregistered predictions P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P7, P10 all PASS.
Wrong-control gauntlet rejects gamma9_added, chi10_subtracted, resistance_ignored, source_sink_swapped.
Invariant search: paired_source_sink_shift, source_gap_generator, net_source_sink_gap, per_channel_core, recovered_channel_sum all PASS.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a side-by-side disciplined formal model evaluation harness for candidate Lagrangians, including wrong-control rejection and invariant search.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the ability to check whether a model is mechanically well-formed (dimension checks, Euler-Lagrange closure) and whether preregistered predictions hold.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If this node is removed, there is no systematic way to compare candidate Lagrangians under identical regimes, no wrong-control gauntlet, and no preregistered prediction tracking.

classification.recommended_atom_action: preserve as methodological harness; do not treat as proof of framework truth

overstatement_risks: Passing checks may be misinterpreted as validating the theological framework.
Algebraic invariants may be mistaken for full Noether conserved quantities.
The harness's checks are necessary but not sufficient for physical truth.
kill_conditions: If dimension checks fail for a candidate, it is not ready.
If anti-model is not exactly the negative of spirit, contrast claim is weak.
If resistance W does not reduce useful part of v2, grace-leak story is weak.
If chi10 does not help and Gamma9 does not hurt, source/sink story is weak.
If Euler-Lagrange equation does not close cleanly, model is not mechanically well-formed.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the harness's checks as executable specifications in Lean, ensuring that all PASS verdicts are mechanically verified.

plain_summary: This document is a methodological harness that evaluates several Lagrangian models (LLC v1, Spirit, Anti, LLC v2) under shared regimes, checking dimension compatibility, response signs, Euler-Lagrange closure, and preregistered predictions. It also runs wrong-control variants to test whether the canonical structure matters, and searches for algebraic invariants. The harness explicitly does not decide whether the framework is true; it only checks disciplined formal behavior. All listed checks pass, but this does not establish physical or theological truth.
